restoration_note: Teaching describes the regenerated rational as holder of the Twelve Aeons of Light — the Lord's complete outgoing structure taken up as the spiritual man's own members. The five faculties + the Calling and Hearing = seven, dwelling of the Living Spirit. The Third Ambassador comes from the Father and stands firm within. Most letter-level gaps in known formulas (Aeons of the Light, Twelve Great, five elements, Pillar's burden-bearing, Living Spirit + First Man, Father of all Aeons and gods) are confidently restored along editor proposals. The deeper lacunae in §§590–594 and §599 — the language of the unmanifest region, hidden chamber, and consummation — are too damaged to fill without invention; marked unrestorable or low.

english_restorations.basis: ~6 Coptic chars before ⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'lower'; reading: 'the lowest of these registers stands at the foremost of the elements.' A bridging connective is plausible but unconstrained.
Coptic gap of 13 chars with partial traces too fragmentary to reconstruct.
Editor's restoration ⲭⲁⲩⲗⲉ ⲍⲁ ⲛ̄ⲍⲣⲏⲱⲉ — standard Pillar-of-Glory predicate, the operative power that bears up the whole cosmos.
Coptic ⲥⲙⲁⲙⲉ ⲉⲧⲁϩ- 'blessing which has-' (relative perfect); a 'come/been set upon them' verb is implied by the immediate ⲡⲥⲙⲁⲙⲉ ⲉⲧⲟ ⲙ̄ⲙⲛⲧⲉϩⲧⲉ that follows.
Greek loan beginning ⲡⲣⲟⲥ-; ⲡⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲭⲏ 'prayer' is one plausible 5-char completion fitting the blessing context, but unconstrained.
Editor's ⲡⲙⲛⲧⲉϩⲧⲉ ⲛ̄ⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the foremost of the Aeons of the Light'; parallels lines 1 and 7–8.
